Microbiome ↔ resistome models.

1. **Associations**: each microbiome feature (alpha diversity and Aitchison PCoA axes 1-3, z-scored) against
   ARG load, richness and Simpson, with the same models as `1.-FFQ_analysis/Scripts/02.Score_associations.Rmd`
   (lm / Poisson / lm, sex + age + BMI + log10 depth, BH within outcome).
2. **Diet vs microbiome**: nested models (covariates → + diet group → + microbiome → both) to see how much of the
   resistome variation is explained by diet and by the microbiome, and whether the diet effect remains after
   accounting for the microbiome.
3. **Community-level concordance**: Procrustes and Mantel test between microbiome and resistome Aitchison distances.
4. **Diet beyond microbial diversity**: diet contrasts of the ARG metrics refitted adding species richness, to
   tell a resistome-specific diet effect from a consequence of community diversity.

**Why assembly size is not a covariate here.** The ARG metrics are read-based (reads mapped to ResFinder), so
the assembly plays no part in measuring them and cannot bias them technically; sequencing depth is the
technical covariate and is already in every model. Assembled Mb is in practice a second measurement of
community diversity (Spearman 0.80 with species richness, which explains 62 % of its variance) and lies on the
path diet → community → ARG detection, so adding it would be adjusting for a mediator twice. It is reported
below only as a collinearity check. Assembly size *is* a legitimate covariate for assembly-based outcomes,
where contig length and assembly quality do affect detection; that is where `3.-Assembly_based` uses it.

Adjusting for species richness is itself a mediator adjustment: it describes how much of the diet effect is not
shared with community richness, and is not a causal "direct effect".

All models use complete cases (GPH_97 has no BMI).

# Data load

```{r data load}
metadata <- read_tsv(here("Data", "Processed", "metadata.tsv"), show_col_types = FALSE)
arg_metrics <- read_tsv(here("Data", "Processed", "arg_metrics.tsv"), show_col_types = FALSE)
microbiome_alpha <- read_tsv(file.path(table_dir, "microbiome_alpha.tsv"), show_col_types = FALSE)
microbiome_pcoa <- read_tsv(file.path(table_dir, "microbiome_aitchison_pcoa.tsv"), show_col_types = FALSE)
assembly_stats <- read_tsv(here("Data", "Processed", "assembly_stats.tsv"), show_col_types = FALSE)

model_data <- metadata %>%
  transmute(sample_id,
            diet_group = factor(diet_group, levels = names(diet_colors)),
            sex = factor(sex, levels = c("Female", "Male")),
            age, bmi, log10_depth = log10(reads)) %>%
  inner_join(arg_metrics, by = "sample_id") %>%
  inner_join(microbiome_alpha %>% transmute(sample_id, log_species = log(observed)), by = "sample_id") %>%
  inner_join(microbiome_alpha %>% rename_with(~ paste0("microbiome_", .x), -sample_id), by = "sample_id") %>%
  inner_join(microbiome_pcoa, by = "sample_id") %>%
  inner_join(assembly_stats %>% transmute(sample_id, log_assembly_Mb = log(assembly_Mb)), by = "sample_id") %>%
  drop_na(sex, age, bmi, log10_depth) %>%
  mutate(across(starts_with("microbiome_"), ~ as.numeric(scale(.x))))

stopifnot(nrow(model_data) == sum(!is.na(metadata$bmi)))

cat("Samples in the models:", nrow(model_data), "\n")

features <- tribble(
  ~feature,               ~label,               ~type,
  "microbiome_observed",  "Species richness",   "Alpha diversity",
  "microbiome_shannon",   "Shannon",            "Alpha diversity",
  "microbiome_simpson",   "Simpson",            "Alpha diversity",
  "microbiome_PC1",       "Aitchison PCoA1",    "Composition",
  "microbiome_PC2",       "Aitchison PCoA2",    "Composition",
  "microbiome_PC3",       "Aitchison PCoA3",    "Composition")

outcomes <- tribble(
  ~outcome,       ~endpoint,       ~family,
  "log_ARG_load", "ARG load",      "gaussian",
  "richness",     "ARG richness",  "poisson",
  "simpson",      "ARG Simpson",   "gaussian")

covariates <- "sex + age + bmi + log10_depth"
```


# 1. Microbiome features and ARG metrics

```{r associations}
fit_feature_model <- function(feature, outcome, family, extra = "") {
  formula_i <- as.formula(paste(outcome, "~", feature, "+", covariates, extra))
  fit <- glm(formula_i, data = model_data, family = family)
  crit <- if (family == "gaussian") qt(0.975, df.residual(fit)) else qnorm(0.975)

  tidy(fit) %>%
    filter(term == feature) %>%
    transmute(estimate, se = std.error, p_value = p.value,
              conf_low = estimate - crit * se,
              conf_high = estimate + crit * se,
              dispersion = sum(residuals(fit, type = "pearson")^2) / df.residual(fit),
              n = nobs(fit))
}

fit_associations <- function(extra = "") {
  expand_grid(features, outcomes) %>%
    mutate(fit = pmap(list(feature, outcome, family), fit_feature_model, extra = extra)) %>%
    unnest(fit) %>%
    group_by(endpoint) %>%
    mutate(p_adj = p.adjust(p_value, method = "BH")) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    mutate(across(c(estimate, conf_low, conf_high),
                  ~ if_else(family == "poisson", exp(.x), .x)),
           effect = if_else(family == "poisson", "IRR", "beta"))
}

associations <- fit_associations()

associations %>%
  select(label, endpoint, effect, estimate, conf_low, conf_high, p_value, p_adj) %>%
  arrange(endpoint, p_value) %>%
  print(n = Inf)
```

Collinearity check: assembled Mb is largely a restatement of species richness, so it is not used as a covariate
(see the header). The numbers behind that statement:

```{r assembly collinearity}
collinearity <- tibble(
  quantity = c("Spearman, assembled Mb vs species richness",
               "Spearman, assembled Mb vs log10 depth",
               "R2 of log assembled Mb ~ species richness",
               "R2 of log assembled Mb ~ log10 depth",
               "R2 of log assembled Mb ~ both"),
  value = c(cor(model_data$log_assembly_Mb, model_data$microbiome_observed, method = "spearman"),
            cor(model_data$log_assembly_Mb, model_data$log10_depth, method = "spearman"),
            summary(lm(log_assembly_Mb ~ log_species, model_data))$r.squared,
            summary(lm(log_assembly_Mb ~ log10_depth, model_data))$r.squared,
            summary(lm(log_assembly_Mb ~ log_species + log10_depth, model_data))$r.squared))
collinearity
```

```{r forest plot, fig.width = 10, fig.height = 4.5}
plot_data <- associations %>%
  mutate(type = factor(type, levels = names(feature_colors)),
         label = fct_rev(fct_inorder(label)),
         endpoint = factor(endpoint, levels = outcomes$endpoint),
         null_value = if_else(effect == "IRR", 1, 0))

plot_associations <- ggplot(plot_data, aes(x = estimate, y = label, colour = type)) +
  geom_vline(aes(xintercept = null_value), linetype = "dashed", colour = "grey50") +
  geom_errorbar(aes(xmin = conf_low, xmax = conf_high), width = 0.2, orientation = "y") +
  geom_point(aes(shape = p_adj < 0.05), size = 2.5) +
  scale_shape_manual(values = c(`FALSE` = 1, `TRUE` = 16), labels = c("q ≥ 0.05", "q < 0.05"), name = NULL) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = feature_colors, name = "Microbiome feature") +
  facet_grid(type ~ endpoint, scales = "free", space = "free_y") +
  labs(x = "Effect per 1-SD increase (beta; IRR for richness)", y = NULL)
```

# 2. Diet group vs microbiome

Microbiome block: Shannon + Aitchison PCoA1-3.
R² for linear models and deviance explained (D²) for the Poisson model.

```{r nested models}
microbiome_terms <- "microbiome_shannon + microbiome_PC1 + microbiome_PC2 + microbiome_PC3"

model_terms <- c(
  "Covariates"        = covariates,
  "Diet group"        = paste(covariates, "+ diet_group"),
  "Microbiome"        = paste(covariates, "+", microbiome_terms),
  "Diet + microbiome" = paste(covariates, "+ diet_group +", microbiome_terms))

fit_nested <- function(outcome, family) {
  map(model_terms, ~ glm(as.formula(paste(outcome, "~", .x)), data = model_data, family = family))
}

explained <- function(fit) 1 - fit$deviance / fit$null.deviance

nested_fits <- outcomes %>%
  mutate(fits = map2(outcome, family, fit_nested))

model_comparison <- nested_fits %>%
  mutate(summary = map(fits, ~ tibble(model = names(.x),
                                      explained = map_dbl(.x, explained),
                                      AIC = map_dbl(.x, AIC)))) %>%
  select(endpoint, family, summary) %>%
  unnest(summary) %>%
  group_by(endpoint) %>%
  mutate(gain_vs_covariates = explained - explained[model == "Covariates"],
         delta_AIC = AIC - min(AIC)) %>%
  ungroup()

# Likelihood-ratio / F tests: each block on top of the other
block_test <- function(fits, family, reduced, full) {
  test <- if (family == "gaussian") "F" else "Chisq"
  a <- anova(fits[[reduced]], fits[[full]], test = test)
  a[[ncol(a)]][2]
}

block_tests <- nested_fits %>%
  transmute(endpoint,
            `Diet group (covariates)`    = map2_dbl(fits, family, block_test, "Covariates", "Diet group"),
            `Diet group (+ microbiome)`  = map2_dbl(fits, family, block_test, "Microbiome", "Diet + microbiome"),
            `Microbiome (covariates)`    = map2_dbl(fits, family, block_test, "Covariates", "Microbiome"),
            `Microbiome (+ diet group)`  = map2_dbl(fits, family, block_test, "Diet group", "Diet + microbiome")) %>%
  pivot_longer(-endpoint, names_to = "test", values_to = "p_value") %>%
  left_join(outcomes %>% transmute(endpoint, test_type = if_else(family == "gaussian", "F", "likelihood ratio")),
            by = "endpoint")

model_comparison
block_tests
```

```{r explained plot}
plot_explained <- model_comparison %>%
  filter(model != "Covariates") %>%
  mutate(model = factor(model, levels = names(block_colors)),
         endpoint = factor(endpoint, levels = outcomes$endpoint)) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = model, y = gain_vs_covariates, fill = model)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.7, colour = "black", linewidth = 0.3) +
  geom_text(aes(label = scales::percent(gain_vs_covariates, accuracy = 0.1)),
            vjust = -0.4, size = 3) +
  facet_wrap(~ endpoint, nrow = 1) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = block_colors, guide = "none") +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::label_percent(accuracy = 1),
                     expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.15))) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Additional variance explained\n(R², D² for richness) over covariates") +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 30, hjust = 1),
        panel.grid.major.x = element_blank())

plot_explained
```


# 3. Microbiome and resistome composition

```{r procrustes}
ps <- readRDS(here("Data", "Processed", "phyloseq_species.rds"))
cpm <- read_tsv(here("Data", "Processed", "cpm_gene_GPH.tsv"), show_col_types = FALSE)

# Same filter and distance as 02.Beta_diversity.Rmd
ps_beta <- ps %>%
  filter_taxa(function(x) mean(x > 0) >= 0.10, prune = TRUE) %>%
  transform_sample_counts(function(x) x / sum(x))

samples <- intersect(sample_names(ps_beta), colnames(cpm))
dist_microbiome <- vegdist(t(as(otu_table(ps_beta), "matrix"))[samples, ], method = "robust.aitchison")
dist_resistome <- vegdist(cpm %>% column_to_rownames("gene_family") %>% t() %>% .[samples, ],
                          method = "robust.aitchison")

pcoa_microbiome <- cmdscale(dist_microbiome, k = 2)
pcoa_resistome <- cmdscale(dist_resistome, k = 2)

protest_result <- protest(pcoa_microbiome, pcoa_resistome, permutations = 9999)
mantel_result <- mantel(dist_microbiome, dist_resistome, method = "spearman", permutations = 9999)

concordance <- tibble(
  test = c("Procrustes (PROTEST)", "Mantel (Spearman)"),
  statistic_name = c("r", "rho"),
  statistic = c(protest_result$t0, mantel_result$statistic),
  p_value = c(protest_result$signif, mantel_result$signif))

concordance
```

```{r procrustes plot}
diet_lookup <- setNames(as.character(metadata$diet_group), metadata$sample_id)

procrustes_df <- tibble(sample_id = samples,
                        diet_group = factor(diet_lookup[samples], levels = names(diet_colors)),
                        x_microbiome = protest_result$X[, 1], y_microbiome = protest_result$X[, 2],
                        x_resistome = protest_result$Yrot[, 1], y_resistome = protest_result$Yrot[, 2])

plot_procrustes <- ggplot(procrustes_df) +
  geom_segment(aes(x = x_microbiome, y = y_microbiome, xend = x_resistome, yend = y_resistome,
                   colour = diet_group), alpha = 0.5, linewidth = 0.4) +
  geom_point(aes(x = x_microbiome, y = y_microbiome, fill = diet_group),
             pch = 21, size = 2.2, colour = "black") +
  geom_point(aes(x = x_resistome, y = y_resistome, fill = diet_group),
             pch = 24, size = 2, colour = "black", alpha = 0.7) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = diet_colors, name = NULL) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = diet_colors, guide = "none") +
  labs(x = "Dimension 1", y = "Dimension 2",
       subtitle = paste0("Microbiome (●) vs resistome (▲) Aitchison PCoA; Procrustes r = ",
                         round(protest_result$t0, 3), ", p = ", signif(protest_result$signif, 3))) +
  theme(panel.border = element_rect(colour = "black", fill = NA, linewidth = 0.6),
        panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
        plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 9, colour = "grey30"))

plot_procrustes
```


# 4. Does diet shape the resistome beyond microbial diversity?

Omnivores have both a richer microbiome and a richer resistome. The diet contrasts of each ARG metric are
refitted adding log species richness. If the diet effect on ARG richness disappears once species richness is in
the model, the resistome difference follows community diversity rather than being a resistome-specific effect of
diet. Effects: ratio for ARG load (log scale) and richness (Poisson), difference for Simpson; Tukey-adjusted
within each model.

```{r diversity adjustment}
adjustments <- c(
  "None"               = "",
  "+ species richness" = "+ log_species")

diversity_fits <- expand_grid(outcomes, adjustment = names(adjustments)) %>%
  mutate(fit = pmap(list(outcome, family, adjustment), function(outcome, family, adjustment) {
    glm(as.formula(paste(outcome, "~ diet_group +", covariates, adjustments[[adjustment]])),
        data = model_data, family = family)
  }))

diet_contrasts <- function(fit) {
  ct <- emmeans(fit, pairwise ~ diet_group, adjust = "tukey")$contrasts
  ci <- as.data.frame(confint(ct))
  tibble(contrast = ci$contrast, estimate = ci$estimate,
         conf_low = ci[[intersect(c("lower.CL", "asymp.LCL"), names(ci))]],
         conf_high = ci[[intersect(c("upper.CL", "asymp.UCL"), names(ci))]],
         p_adj = as.data.frame(ct)$p.value)
}

diet_beyond_diversity <- diversity_fits %>%
  mutate(contrasts = map(fit, diet_contrasts)) %>%
  select(endpoint, outcome, adjustment, contrasts) %>%
  unnest(contrasts) %>%
  mutate(effect = if_else(outcome == "simpson", "difference", "ratio"),
         across(c(estimate, conf_low, conf_high), ~ if_else(effect == "ratio", exp(.x), .x)),
         adjustment = factor(adjustment, levels = names(adjustments)))

diet_beyond_diversity %>%
  select(endpoint, contrast, adjustment, estimate, conf_low, conf_high, p_adj) %>%
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~ signif(.x, 3))) %>%
  print(n = Inf)

# Coefficients of the diversity term (log-log: elasticity for load and richness)
diversity_terms <- diversity_fits %>%
  mutate(terms = map(fit, ~ tidy(.x) %>%
                       filter(term == "log_species") %>%
                       select(term, estimate, se = std.error, p_value = p.value))) %>%
  select(endpoint, adjustment, terms) %>%
  unnest(terms)

diversity_terms %>% mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~ signif(.x, 3)))
```

```{r diversity adjustment plot, fig.width = 10, fig.height = 4.5}
adjustment_colors <- c("None" = "grey40", "+ species richness" = "#338040")

plot_beyond_diversity <- diet_beyond_diversity %>%
  mutate(endpoint = factor(endpoint, levels = outcomes$endpoint),
         contrast = fct_rev(fct_inorder(contrast)),
         null_value = if_else(effect == "ratio", 1, 0)) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = estimate, y = contrast, colour = adjustment)) +
  geom_vline(aes(xintercept = null_value), linetype = "dashed", colour = "grey50") +
  # group = adjustment in both layers: otherwise the shape aesthetic enters the dodge grouping of the points
  # and they land on the other model's error bar whenever the two models differ in significance
  geom_errorbar(aes(xmin = conf_low, xmax = conf_high, group = adjustment), width = 0.25, orientation = "y",
                position = position_dodge(width = 0.7)) +
  geom_point(aes(shape = p_adj < 0.05, group = adjustment), size = 2.3, position = position_dodge(width = 0.7)) +
  scale_shape_manual(values = c(`FALSE` = 1, `TRUE` = 16),
                     labels = c("adjusted p ≥ 0.05", "adjusted p < 0.05"), name = NULL) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = adjustment_colors, name = "Adjustment") +
  facet_wrap(~ endpoint, scales = "free_x") +
  labs(x = "Diet contrast (ratio; difference for Simpson), Tukey 95% CI", y = NULL) +
  guides(colour = guide_legend(nrow = 2))

plot_beyond_diversity
```

```{r save}
write_tsv(associations %>% select(-family), file.path(table_dir, "microbiome_ARG_associations.tsv"))
write_tsv(collinearity, file.path(table_dir, "assembly_size_collinearity.tsv"))
write_tsv(diet_beyond_diversity, file.path(table_dir, "diet_contrasts_beyond_diversity.tsv"))

write_tsv(procrustes_df, file.path(table_dir, "procrustes_coordinates.tsv"))

# Spearman correlation of ARG and species richness on all participants with both measures (no covariates)
richness_pairs <- arg_metrics %>% inner_join(microbiome_alpha, by = "sample_id")
rho_test <- cor.test(richness_pairs$richness, richness_pairs$observed, method = "spearman", exact = FALSE)
write_tsv(tibble(x = "ARG richness", y = "Species richness", spearman_rho = unname(rho_test$estimate),
                 p_value = rho_test$p.value, n = nrow(richness_pairs)),
          file.path(table_dir, "richness_correlation.tsv"))

ggsave(file.path(plot_dir, "Microbiome_ARG_associations.png"), plot_associations, width = 10, height = 4.5, dpi = 600, bg = "white")
ggsave(file.path(plot_dir, "Diet_vs_microbiome_explained.png"), plot_explained, width = 9, height = 4.5, dpi = 600, bg = "white")
ggsave(file.path(plot_dir, "Microbiome_resistome_procrustes.png"), plot_procrustes, width = 6, height = 5.5, dpi = 600, bg = "white")
ggsave(file.path(plot_dir, "Diet_contrasts_beyond_diversity.png"), plot_beyond_diversity, width = 10, height = 4.5, dpi = 600, bg = "white")
```
